reason: SteerBridge is a ~194-225 person, $33M-revenue (2024) veteran-led federal IT services and professional-services contractor in Vienna VA supporting 32 contracts across two countries (Washington Technology Fast 50 #10, Inc. 5000 #1178, CMMI ML3) - not a Series A/B defense tech product startup of 8-30 people, so it fails Barry Hess's ICP on type, stage and size; it is itself a consultancy selling the same federal-acquisition and cleared-technical-leadership services he offers, and its live postings (Security Engineer, Security Architect, Construction Manager, Tier 1 Help Desk Technician) are billable delivery headcount for existing programs, not a confession of prototype-stuck-in-the-valley-of-death pain.
